sn14.6:1.1: (Section II Bāhira-pañcakam) Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati || || Dhātunānattam vo bhikkhave desissāmi || tam suṇātha || pe|| || Katamañca bhikkhave dhātunānattaṃ || || Rūpadhātu saddadhātu gandhadhātu rasadhātu phoṭṭhabbadhātu dhammadhātu || || Idaṃ vuccati bhikkhave dhātunānattanti || || Chaṭṭhaṃ || ||
